source_equivalence.exact_and_permutation: Historical shapley.py subset weights, iid permutation mean and ddof1/M variance; exact dimension guard remains 1<=d<=8
source_equivalence.variance: Observed sample variance across B minus mean MC variance, raw diagnostic and nonnegative-clipped selector variance
source_equivalence.selection: Historical forward_path: sum scores - eta/d sum pairwise absolute Spearman; original index tie break; full path retained even for negative increments
source_equivalence.redundancy: All synthetic predictors finite numeric; direct average ranks equal positive-affine standardized ranks, no encoder fit needed
source_equivalence.new_scope: B=4, d=6, M64, M16 prefix, training-only nested row schedules and exact finite-B diagnostic; no historical prediction or utility cache reused

correlated_groups.X: zero-mean joint Gaussian, unit diagonal; corr(X1,X2)=corr(X3,X4)=.9; all other cross-correlations zero

xor.y: XOR(X1>0,X2>0), each label independently flipped with probability .05

generation.train_test: Independent seed coordinates, train/test row IDs must carry split prefix in future persisted files
generation.random_generator: numpy.random.default_rng with frozen environment; generate arrays before Bernoulli/flip uniforms, as source code binds
generation.persistence_today: none; no-fit generated arrays exist only in memory

nested_design.sampling: stratified without replacement, Hamilton class allocation to floor(n*fraction+.5); original class ID tie break
nested_design.folding: shuffle members within class with one seed, numpy.array_split into two validation folds; complementary training rows
nested_design.test_access: Only after selection commitments are saved and hashed; test outcomes never tune any frozen choice
nested_design.selection_algorithm_randomness: Main permutation and model seeds fixed across q=0..5; contribution/partition data resamples vary; all CSR branches paired
nested_design.random_control_stability: Random feature path also fixed across q; its stability is conditional on fixed algorithm randomness and may equal one without recovery

utility.metric: arithmetic mean of the two held-out utility-fold F1 values
utility.empty_subset: training-fold class prevalence constant, thresholded at .5; no classifier or encoder fit
utility.nonempty_tables: all 63 nonempty subsets, 2 fold fits per subset; full table reused for main and diagnostics
utility.preprocessing: one numeric standardizer per classifier attempt fit on that attempt's training rows only, mean and population SD, zero SD replaced by1; no missing values permitted
utility.final_training_rows: 480 selector rows, same rows for all CSR/random/full-feature arms
utility.selection_values: Only frozen M64 permutations read table marginals; exact values are computed/reported only after selector commitment
utility.fit_cache: Deduplicate only identical layer/data/q/game/fold/mask/context within the declared run; never historical artifacts or cross-game data

LR.convergence_warning: failed counted attempt; stop package, no grid expansion or silent retry

learners.model_failure_policy: Reserve before fit, record failure/incomplete status, stop and investigate; retries only explicit and charged against hard caps; no substitution of an easier scenario

selection.C: C1 uses max(0, sample_variance(phi_hat_b)-mean(mc_variance_b)); C0 uses uncorrected sample variance
selection.S: S1 subtracts lambda*SD; S0 uses mean contribution only
selection.R: R1 penalizes accumulated redundancy by eta/d; R0 eta0
selection.aliases_accounting: Retain eight logical rows, mark 001=101 and 000=100; physical identical-model caching allowed, duplicates never independent evidence

C_diagnostics.target: ddof1 sample variance of exact Shapley contributions in the same four realized games

XOR: joint recovery of both signal variables
endpoints.other_ks_and_CSR: prespecified secondary diagnostics; no selecting winning scenarios/learners
endpoints.stable_wrong_sets: stability must be interpreted together with recovery and prediction; not counted as benefit
endpoints.statistical_unit: generated dataset, eight independent seeds per scenario; LR/RF on XOR paired but reported separately
endpoints.nested_repetitions: 6 resamples, 20 streams, 6 features, 15 Jaccard pairs are not independent sample-size multipliers
endpoints.summary: first aggregate inside dataset then show all eight paired values, mean, median, range, positive/negative/zero counts; no unplanned significance filtering

intentional_sharing: all CSR labels and k values share a selector's rows/utility tables
XOR LR/RF share train/test data and nested partitions
main/model seeds fixed across six selection resamples
M16 is prefix of corresponding M64 sequence
random-feature path fixed across resamples; conditional stability only
